description: Read which kinds of roles are hiring most in a place (city, region or country): open postings by role category, with total open postings, employers and sectors. When the place has too few role types it widens to the region, the country or worldwide; scope and locationLabel say which area the numbers cover. Counts are postings, not hires. Use it when the person does not yet know what to look for; use search_jobs once they have a role in mind and get_market_insights for one role's pay and size.
name: get_local_demand
title: Read local job demand
